functions.name: asAgent
functions.description: Configures the resource as an agent that supports the specified protocol.
functions.remarks:
Call this method once for each protocol/path pair exposed by the resource. Repeated pairs are ignored.
Responses and ACP agent names are protocol
identifiers and do not need to match the Aspire resource name.
functions.returns: A reference to the `IResourceBuilder`1` for chaining.

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.description: The protocol supported by the agent.

parameters.name: agentName
parameters.description: The registered agent name for Responses or ACP. When omitted, the dashboard command prompts for it.

functions.name: asAgentWithInvocationMode
functions.description: Configures the resource as an A2A agent using the specified dashboard invocation mode.
functions.remarks: Streaming must be explicitly requested and is available only when the A2A agent card advertises support.
functions.returns: A reference to the `IResourceBuilder`1` for chaining.

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.description: The protocol supported by the agent.

parameters.name: invocationMode
parameters.description: The invocation mode used by dashboard commands.

functions.name: asAgentWithPath
functions.description: Configures the resource as an agent that supports the specified protocol using a custom protocol path.
functions.remarks: Configure each protocol independently when a resource exposes multiple protocols or non-default paths.
functions.returns: A reference to the `IResourceBuilder`1` for chaining.
functions.signature: asAgentWithPath(agentCustomPath: string, protocol: AgentProtocol, agentName?: string): IResourceWithEndpoints

parameters.name: agentCustomPath
parameters.description: The custom path for protocol-specific dashboard commands and URLs.

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.description: The protocol supported by the agent.

parameters.name: agentName
parameters.description: The registered agent name for Responses or ACP. When omitted, the dashboard command prompts for it.

functions.name: asAgentWithPathAndInvocationMode
functions.description: Configures the resource as an A2A agent using a custom protocol path and dashboard invocation mode.
functions.remarks: Use this overload when an A2A agent has both a non-default agent-card path and streaming invocation enabled.
functions.returns: A reference to the `IResourceBuilder`1` for chaining.
functions.signature: asAgentWithPathAndInvocationMode(agentCustomPath: string, protocol: AgentProtocol, invocationMode: A2AInvocationMode): IResourceWithEndpoints

parameters.name: agentCustomPath
parameters.description: The custom path for protocol-specific dashboard commands and URLs.

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.description: The protocol supported by the agent.

parameters.name: invocationMode
parameters.description: The invocation mode used by dashboard commands.

functions.name: withMcpToolCommands
functions.description: Adds commands for invoking tools on the resource's configured MCP server.
functions.remarks:
Configure the MCP endpoint with `WithMcpServer` before calling this method.
Adds an interactive dashboard command, an API command accepting a tool name and JSON arguments,
and an MCP endpoint URL. The interactive command is highlighted only if the resource
does not already have a highlighted command. Endpoint resolution uses the existing
`McpServerEndpointAnnotation` without changing its configuration.
This method has no effect in publish mode.

enumTypes.name: A2AInvocationMode
enumTypes.description: Specifies how dashboard commands invoke an A2A agent.

memberDocs.name: Streaming
memberDocs.description: Streams the A2A response when the agent advertises streaming support.

enumTypes.name: AgentProtocol
enumTypes.description: Specifies the protocols supported by an agent resource.
